newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Rabobank launches Russian Black Earth fund.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Rabobank launches Russian Black Earth fund.

text.p: A consortium led by Rabobank International has set up a fund investing in privatised companies in the Black Earth region of southern Russia, Rabobank said on Tuesday.
The Rabo Black Earth Regional Venture Fund will manage funds put up mainly by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), it said.
"The agreement with EBRD to manage the fund...signalled a new step on the road to expanding the activities of Rabobank International in central and eastern Europe," Rabobank said in a statement.
Rabobank is majority shareholder in the consortium, which further includes Russian investment consultants EWIC/Larive, Flemish investment company GIMV and Dutch Corpeq Ventures.
Rabobank said at least 75 percent of investments would be channelled to the Black Earth region some 600 kilometres south of Moscow.
The remainder would go to projects elsewhere in Russia, it said.
